title: Chart Grow
summary: A line chart draws itself across the frame behind the speaker and spikes up with a glowing label.
description: A minimal chart appears on the wall behind the speaker: faint grid lines, day labels along the top, and a white line that draws itself left to right with a glowing tip. At the take-off point it turns into a glowing accent-coloured spike with a gradient fill, a dashed guide and a label pill (SCALE ↗) that pops in. The speaker is cut out and stays in front, so the line passes behind their head.

options.labels: x-axis labels across the top, e.g. ["M","T","W","T","F","S","S"] or ["JAN","FEB","MAR","APR"]
options.values: one height per label, 0 = bottom of the chart, 1 = top (resampled if the count differs)
options.highlightFrom: index of the label where the line turns into the glowing spike (0 = first label)
options.pill: label text in the pill at the take-off point ("SCALE", "+312%"); empty string = no pill
options.arrow: draw the ↗ arrow inside the pill
options.pillInFront: keep the pill in front of the speaker (true) or behind them like the line (false)
options.at: when the chart starts appearing (seconds or "@word")
options.drawDuration: seconds the line takes to draw from first to last point
options.outAt: optional: when the chart fades away (null = hold to the end; it also leaves automatically when an effect window ends early)
options.lineColor: colour of the line before the spike
options.dim: how much to darken the wall behind the chart so it reads (0-0.5)
options.region: "auto" (fitted around the speaker's head) or [x0, y0, x1, y1] as 0-1 fractions: y0 = label row, y1 = chart bottom
